title: WorkflowInput
description: Output contract of the Request Analyzer (PART B system prompt). Consumed by the deterministic estimator. Contains NO prices and NO token counts.

question.description: Specific, answerable question for the user.

provenance.description: Where a metric VALUE came from — not how it is being used. DERIVED_FROM_ASSET means measured then transformed by a stated rule (provider normalization, or a resize the user accepted); it requires transform_rule. Changing detail_mode alone never changes provenance. DEFAULT_APPLIED requires a matching assumptions[] entry and caps task confidence at MEDIUM. MISSING requires a matching missing_data entry. A measured value always overrides a default.

languages.description: Three separate facts. Conflating them misprices the workflow: only payload_languages enters the cost math.

ui_language.description: Interface locale. Costs nothing; drives RTL layout only.

instruction_language.description: Language THIS REQUEST is written in. Selects the parser lexicon.

payload_languages.description: Language of the BILLED CONTENT. Shares should sum to ~1.

parseMeta.description: How this task graph was produced. The L2 parse is itself a billable LLM call and must be metered as system_overhead on the estimate.

volume.description: Executions of this task. A loop over 500 docs is one task with volume 500. Arabic-Indic and Chinese numerals must be converted before extraction.

expands_from.description: Parent task id when a compound verb expanded into a pair. translate and summarize are BOTH read and write — classifying either as a single task undercounts by roughly one document.

execution_probability.description: Below 1 for conditional branches ("summarize it if it's over 10 pages"). Multiplies effective volume.

expected_output_band.description: Selects a calibrated prior downstream. NOT itself a token estimate.

doc_class.description: Selects the seed default when character_count is absent. Seed values are SEED_UNCALIBRATED and must be replaced from observed runs.

script_mix.description: Proportions, not a single label. Mixed Arabic/Latin/Han documents are the norm in Gulf workflows and the tokenizer follows the mix.

arabic_vocalized.description: Convenience flag for bucket selection, DERIVED from diacritic_density by threshold. Do not set it independently — vocalization is a spectrum and a raw boolean snaps partially-vocalized text to whichever extreme misprices it.

diacritic_density.description: Measured diacritics per consonant. The underlying value the calibration table is keyed on and the UI displays. Most real Arabic is partially vocalized — diacritics only on genuinely ambiguous words — so this, not the boolean, is what drives the ratio.

pdf_has_text_layer.description: null = UNKNOWN and BLOCKING. Text-layer PDF is context ingestion; a scanned PDF is vision OCR priced per page in image tiles. No default is defensible across that gap.

page_count.description: Multi-page documents multiply the tile grid per page. Surface pages x tiles_per_page as its own estimate line.

detected_script.description: Drives min_legible_edge_px. Mixed content takes the STRICTEST floor present, never the average.

fidelity_critical.description: User marked this OCR-critical. Blocks the resize rung of the disposition ladder entirely.

asset_disposition.description: Outcome of the oversized/out-of-spec ladder. The estimator NEVER mutates the asset — a resize is a proposal the user accepted or declined.

original_dimensions.description: WxH as measured, always retained even when a transform was applied.

transform_rule.description: Required when provenance is DERIVED_FROM_ASSET. Names the rule, e.g. the provider's normalization or the accepted resize.

recomputed_tile_delta.description: tiles(scaled) - tiles(original). A resize is only proposed when this is negative.

has_stable_prefix.description: Caching candidate: same system prompt/tool block reused across calls.

data_residency_constraint.description: Jurisdiction or policy the user actually stated. Null when unstated — do not infer.

basis.description: Why this value was chosen. Use 'DEFAULT_APPLIED' for a seed baseline. Never 'typical' without a calibration reference.

seed_provenance.description: SEED_UNCALIBRATED forces LOW confidence and carries a standing task to replace it from observed runs.
